tasks.prepare: deno task install && deno task fonts && deno task share:fonts && deno task themes && deno task licenses && deno task build:info
tasks.dev: deno task content:fetch && deno task prepare && deno task model && deno task app:images && (deno task model:watch & cd frontend/app && deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:vite dev)
tasks.build: deno task content:fetch && deno task content:check && deno task model && deno task prepare && deno task app:images && rm -rf public && cd frontend/app && APP_OUT=../../public deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:vite build
tasks.content:verify: deno task content:check && deno task model && deno task prepare && deno task app:images && cd frontend/app && APP_OUT=../../generated/content-check deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:vite build
tasks.lint: biome ci . && taplo fmt --check && taplo lint && actionlint && deno task conventions
tasks.typecheck: deno check tools tests frontend/app/tools frontend/app/tests/unit && deno task app:check
tasks.check: deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test
tasks.ci: deno task check && deno task test:app && deno task validate:html
tasks.app:build: cd frontend/app && deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:vite build
tasks.app:build:fixtures: deno task prepare && deno task content:check tests/fixtures/content && deno task model tests/fixtures/content && deno task app:images && cd frontend/app && APP_OUT=../../generated/fixture-app deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:vite build
tasks.app:check: cd frontend/app && deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:@sveltejs/kit sync && deno run -A --config ../../deno.json npm:svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
tasks.test:app: deno task app:build:fixtures && deno run -A npm:@playwright/test test --config frontend/app/playwright.config.ts
tasks.browsers: deno run -A npm:@playwright/test install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
